questions.prompt: Turn, 8 clean outs, one card left. A fair quick estimate is…
questions.explanation: Eight outs times two is about 16 percent with one card to come.

questions.prompt: Flop, you have a nut flush draw and one overcard. A careful count is…

choices.text: Nine flush outs, plus any overcard outs that are still clean against the betting range.

questions.explanation: Do not turn the overcard into extra flush outs. Add it only if that card actually wins.

questions.prompt: You have 4 outs on the river. Calling is mainly about…

choices.text: Always calling because any out can hit.
Whether the price is better than about 8%, and whether the out is clean.

questions.explanation: Four outs is about 8 percent. You need a very good price, and the out must actually win.
Only one rank completes a gutshot, and there are four cards of that rank.
